guide.title: Jackson Hole Golf & Tennis Club: Golf in Jackson, Wyoming
guide.intro: Golf Digest's 2025-'26 ranking of the best golf courses in Wyoming lists Jackson Hole Golf & Tennis Club fourth, with the access label "Public." The three courses ranked above it — Shooting Star Golf Club in Teton Village, WY, and Snake River Sporting Club and 3 Creek Ranch Golf Club, both in Jackson, WY — are each labelled "Private," so this guide is built around the highest-ranked course an ordinary traveller can book. The club sits near Jackson, in Teton County, on Spring Gulch Road. It is semi-private: its own site states, "Semi-private Club with daily tee times available to non-members, 1pm-2pm daily." That span is the fixed afternoon block of tee times sold to the public, not a booking window — reservations can be made online at any hour.

sections.heading: Getting there
sections.body: Jackson Hole Airport (JAC) is a public airport located seven miles north of Jackson, in Teton County, Wyoming, and is the only commercial airport in the United States located inside a national park, Grand Teton National Park. From downtown Jackson, the club's own directions give a route of 7.91 miles: north on N Center St toward E Deloney Ave, right onto N Cache Dr, which carries US-189, US-191, US-26 and US-89 together for 6.8 miles, then left onto Golf Course Rd for 0.5 miles and left onto Spring Gulch Rd for 0.5 miles, ending at 5000 Spring Gulch Rd. From Teton Village, the club's directions give a total of 20.40 miles. Idaho Falls, Idaho, lies 88 miles from Jackson via US-26.

sections.heading: Playing it as a day guest
sections.body: Jackson Hole Golf & Tennis Club is semi-private. Its own site states: "Semi-private Club with daily tee times available to non-members, 1pm-2pm daily." The 1pm-2pm span is when non-members tee off, not when they may call: the club sells the public a fixed afternoon block, and its booking engine lists only tee times between 1:00pm and 1:40pm. Reservations can be made online at any hour through the tee-time link at jhgtc.com, or by phone at the Pro Shop, 307.733.3111 x1. No lodging or resort stay is required. Guests who do not show for a tee time, or have not cancelled at least five days in advance, are charged the full greens fee. The club's 2026 rate card lists a daily green fee of $195 from opening through May 22 and $300 from May 23 to close, both for the 1pm-2pm non-member block, and both including tax, cart rental and use of the practice facilities. Rental clubs are $95 per person per day. The golf course opens in early May and closes in mid-October, so there is no winter golf here.

sections.heading: The course itself
sections.body: Jackson Hole's original course was unveiled in 1965, designed by California-based architect Bob Baldock. Two years after it opened, Laurance Rockefeller purchased the property and appointed Robert Trent Jones Jr. to redesign the layout. Vail Resorts acquired the Grand Teton Lodge Company in 1999 and spent the best part of eight years carrying out improvements at the club, including a redesign of the 1st and 15th holes, twenty new tees added to increase overall length, and a new irrigation system. The course hosted the 1988 U.S. Amateur Public Links and the 1993 U.S. Women's Amateur Public Links.

sections.heading: The weekend around the course
sections.body: Jackson is the basecamp. Hotel Jackson, at 120 N Glenwood St, sits on Jackson's Town Square, with on-site dining at FIGS and the rooftop Juliette. Snake River Grill, at 84 E. Broadway on the Town Square, is a modern American grill with a wood-burning oven, open nightly from 5pm to 9pm. At the club itself, the North Grille serves lunch, Après Golf and dinner through the summer season, and reservations are strongly encouraged.

sections.heading: Day two: Teton Reserve, in Victor, Idaho
sections.body: For a second round, cross the state line. Teton Reserve, in Victor, Idaho — a different county in a different state, Teton County, Idaho, not Teton County, Wyoming — is labelled "Public" by Golf Digest and was designed by Hale Irwin. The operator's own site states the course is "located in Victor, Idaho just 23 miles from Jackson Hole, Wyoming," and it takes bookings through a 24/7 online tee-time booking engine. Non-resident green fees for the main season, June 1 through September 14, are $95 walking and $110 riding for 18 holes; in the early and late season, before June 1 and after September 14, they are $55 walking and $70 riding. Teton Pines Resort and Golf Club, in Wilson, Wyoming, is not an option for an ordinary traveller: its own site limits outside play to "very limited afternoon reciprocal tee times," arranged through a home club's golf professional, reservable no more than seven days ahead, and only after 2pm.

faq.question: How do I book a tee time at Jackson Hole Golf & Tennis Club?
faq.answer: Reservations can be made online at any hour through the tee-time link at jhgtc.com, or by phone at the Pro Shop, 307.733.3111 x1. No lodging or resort stay, membership or sponsor is required.

faq.question: Can I play in the morning?
faq.answer: No. The club sells non-members a fixed afternoon block: its own site states tee times are available to non-members "1pm-2pm daily," and its booking engine lists only tee times between 1:00pm and 1:40pm. That span governs when you play, not when you may book — booking itself is open online at any hour.

faq.question: What does a round cost?
faq.answer: The club's 2026 rate card lists a daily green fee of $195 from opening through May 22 and $300 from May 23 to close, both for the 1pm-2pm non-member block and both including tax, cart rental and use of the practice facilities. Rental clubs are $95 per person per day.

faq.question: When is the course open?
faq.answer: The golf course opens in early May and closes in mid-October. There is no winter golf here, so plan a spring or autumn visit around that window.

faq.question: Where is the club, and how far is it from town?
faq.answer: Near Jackson, in Teton County, Wyoming, on Spring Gulch Road. The club's own directions give a route of 7.91 miles from downtown Jackson, by way of US-189/US-191/US-26/US-89, Golf Course Rd and Spring Gulch Rd, and a route of 20.40 miles from Teton Village.

faq.question: Which course should I play on day two?
faq.answer: Teton Reserve, in Victor, Idaho, labelled "Public" by Golf Digest and 23 miles from Jackson Hole by the operator's own account. It books through a 24/7 online tee-time engine, unlike Teton Pines Resort and Golf Club in Wilson, Wyoming, which limits outside play to very limited afternoon reciprocal times arranged through a home club professional.

places.name: Jackson Hole Golf & Tennis Club
places.summary: Fourth on Golf Digest's 2025-'26 ranking of the best golf courses in Wyoming, labelled "Public," and the highest-ranked course in the state open to non-members. Semi-private, near Jackson in Teton County on Spring Gulch Road. Designed by Bob Baldock in 1965 and redesigned by Robert Trent Jones Jr. for Laurance Rockefeller two years later. Non-members play a fixed 1pm-2pm afternoon block; booking is online at any hour. The 2026 daily green fee is $195 through May 22 and $300 from May 23 to close. Open early May to mid-October.
